question: Which active accounts in any system are not linked to a person, and what privileged or production access do they have?

queries.purpose: Count active unmatched accounts by system.
queries.sql: SELECT system, COUNT(*) AS active_unmatched_accounts FROM (SELECT 'idp' AS system, account_id FROM idp_accounts WHERE person_id IS NULL AND status = 'active' UNION ALL SELECT 'workspace', account_id FROM workspace_accounts WHERE person_id IS NULL AND status = 'active' UNION ALL SELECT 'github', account_id FROM github_accounts WHERE person_id IS NULL AND status = 'active') GROUP BY system ORDER BY system

queries.purpose: List active unmatched account identifiers and recent activity.
queries.sql: SELECT 'idp' AS system, account_id, username AS account_name, NULL AS account_type, last_login_at AS last_activity_at FROM idp_accounts WHERE person_id IS NULL AND status = 'active' UNION ALL SELECT 'workspace', account_id, primary_email, NULL, last_login_at FROM workspace_accounts WHERE person_id IS NULL AND status = 'active' UNION ALL SELECT 'github', account_id, login, account_type, last_active_at FROM github_accounts WHERE person_id IS NULL AND status = 'active' ORDER BY system, account_name

queries.purpose: Check current GitHub organization and team roles for the unmatched account.
queries.sql: SELECT ga.account_id, ga.login, 'organization' AS scope_type, gom.membership_id AS grant_id, NULL AS scope_id, NULL AS scope_name, gom.org_role AS role, gom.source, gom.granted_at FROM github_accounts ga JOIN github_org_memberships gom ON gom.account_id = ga.account_id AND gom.revoked_at IS NULL WHERE ga.person_id IS NULL AND ga.status = 'active' UNION ALL SELECT ga.account_id, ga.login, 'team', gtm.membership_id, gt.team_id, gt.name, gtm.role, gtm.source, gtm.granted_at FROM github_accounts ga JOIN github_team_memberships gtm ON gtm.account_id = ga.account_id AND gtm.revoked_at IS NULL JOIN github_teams gt ON gt.team_id = gtm.team_id WHERE ga.person_id IS NULL AND ga.status = 'active' ORDER BY account_id, scope_type, scope_name
queries.error: OperationalError: 1st ORDER BY term does not match any column in the result set

queries.purpose: Find current direct and team repository access for active unmatched GitHub accounts.
queries.sql: SELECT ga.account_id, ga.login, 'direct' AS access_path, grc.permission_id, NULL AS membership_id, gr.repository_id, gr.name AS repository_name, gr.sensitivity, gr.visibility, gr.archived, grc.permission, grc.approval_reference, grc.granted_at, grc.expires_at FROM github_accounts ga JOIN github_repo_collaborators grc ON grc.account_id = ga.account_id AND grc.revoked_at IS NULL AND (grc.expires_at IS NULL OR grc.expires_at > '2026-08-15T12:00:00Z') JOIN github_repositories gr ON gr.repository_id = grc.repository_id WHERE ga.person_id IS NULL AND ga.status = 'active' UNION ALL SELECT ga.account_id, ga.login, 'team', gtrp.permission_id, gtm.membership_id, gr.repository_id, gr.name, gr.sensitivity, gr.visibility, gr.archived, gtrp.permission, NULL, gtrp.granted_at, NULL FROM github_accounts ga JOIN github_team_memberships gtm ON gtm.account_id = ga.account_id AND gtm.revoked_at IS NULL JOIN github_team_repo_permissions gtrp ON gtrp.team_id = gtm.team_id AND gtrp.revoked_at IS NULL JOIN github_repositories gr ON gr.repository_id = gtrp.repository_id WHERE ga.person_id IS NULL AND ga.status = 'active' ORDER BY account_id, repository_name, access_path

queries.purpose: Check recent audit events involving active unmatched GitHub accounts.
queries.sql: SELECT ae.event_id, ae.occurred_at, ae.system, ae.event_type, ae.actor_type, ae.actor_id, ae.target_type, ae.target_id, ae.source, ae.outcome, ae.details_json FROM audit_events ae JOIN github_accounts ga ON (ae.actor_type = 'account' AND ae.actor_id = ga.account_id) OR (ae.target_type = 'account' AND ae.target_id = ga.account_id) WHERE ga.person_id IS NULL AND ga.status = 'active' ORDER BY ae.occurred_at DESC LIMIT 50

queries.purpose: Check current GitHub organization and team roles for active unmatched accounts.
queries.sql: SELECT * FROM (SELECT ga.account_id AS account_id, ga.login AS login, 'organization' AS scope_type, gom.membership_id AS grant_id, NULL AS scope_id, NULL AS scope_name, gom.org_role AS role, gom.source AS source, gom.granted_at AS granted_at FROM github_accounts ga JOIN github_org_memberships gom ON gom.account_id = ga.account_id AND gom.revoked_at IS NULL WHERE ga.person_id IS NULL AND ga.status = 'active' UNION ALL SELECT ga.account_id, ga.login, 'team', gtm.membership_id, gt.team_id, gt.name, gtm.role, gtm.source, gtm.granted_at FROM github_accounts ga JOIN github_team_memberships gtm ON gtm.account_id = ga.account_id AND gtm.revoked_at IS NULL JOIN github_teams gt ON gt.team_id = gtm.team_id WHERE ga.person_id IS NULL AND ga.status = 'active') x ORDER BY account_id, scope_type, scope_name

queries.purpose: Find current direct and team repository access for active unmatched GitHub accounts.
queries.sql: SELECT * FROM (SELECT ga.account_id AS account_id, ga.login AS login, 'direct' AS access_path, grc.permission_id AS permission_id, NULL AS membership_id, gr.repository_id AS repository_id, gr.name AS repository_name, gr.sensitivity AS sensitivity, gr.visibility AS visibility, gr.archived AS archived, grc.permission AS permission, grc.approval_reference AS approval_reference, grc.granted_at AS granted_at, grc.expires_at AS expires_at FROM github_accounts ga JOIN github_repo_collaborators grc ON grc.account_id = ga.account_id AND grc.revoked_at IS NULL AND (grc.expires_at IS NULL OR grc.expires_at > '2026-08-15T12:00:00Z') JOIN github_repositories gr ON gr.repository_id = grc.repository_id WHERE ga.person_id IS NULL AND ga.status = 'active' UNION ALL SELECT ga.account_id, ga.login, 'team', gtrp.permission_id, gtm.membership_id, gr.repository_id, gr.name, gr.sensitivity, gr.visibility, gr.archived, gtrp.permission, NULL, gtrp.granted_at, NULL FROM github_accounts ga JOIN github_team_memberships gtm ON gtm.account_id = ga.account_id AND gtm.revoked_at IS NULL JOIN github_team_repo_permissions gtrp ON gtrp.team_id = gtm.team_id AND gtrp.revoked_at IS NULL JOIN github_repositories gr ON gr.repository_id = gtrp.repository_id WHERE ga.person_id IS NULL AND ga.status = 'active') x ORDER BY account_id, repository_name, access_path

report.summary: One active account is unlinked: GitHub service account legacy-release-bot. It has direct write access to the private, production-critical payments-api repository and pushed there hours before the snapshot.

findings.title: Production write access
findings.statement: legacy-release-bot has unexpired direct write access to the private, production-critical payments-api repository.

findings.title: One unmatched active account
findings.statement: The only active account without a person link is GitHub service account legacy-release-bot; none appear in IdP or Workspace.

findings.title: Access is actively used
findings.statement: legacy-release-bot successfully pushed three commits to payments-api on 2026-08-14, about 12 hours before the snapshot.

findings.title: Manual organization membership
findings.statement: legacy-release-bot is a manually granted GitHub organization member dating from 2023-02-14, but it is not an organization owner.

data_gaps: A NULL person link does not identify the service account’s human owner, and the snapshot has no service-account ownership registry.
Audit logs are incomplete, so the recent push proves account activity but not which human or process used its credentials.
recommended_actions: Identify and document the accountable owner for legacy-release-bot.
Confirm production write access is still required and replace it with narrower or time-limited access if possible.
Review and rotate the account’s credentials because it has active production access.
Add monitoring for pushes and permission changes by unmatched service accounts.

proposed_tools.name: list_active_unmatched_accounts
proposed_tools.description: Lists active IdP, Workspace, and GitHub accounts that have no linked person, including account identifiers and recent activity.
proposed_tools.sql: SELECT 'idp' AS system, account_id, username AS account_name, NULL AS account_type, status, last_login_at AS last_activity_at FROM idp_accounts WHERE person_id IS NULL AND status = 'active' UNION ALL SELECT 'workspace', account_id, primary_email, NULL, status, last_login_at FROM workspace_accounts WHERE person_id IS NULL AND status = 'active' UNION ALL SELECT 'github', account_id, login, account_type, status, last_active_at FROM github_accounts WHERE person_id IS NULL AND status = 'active'

proposed_tools.name: get_current_github_repository_access
proposed_tools.description: Returns current direct and team-derived repository permissions for a GitHub account, with sensitivity and permission grant IDs.

parameters.name: snapshot_at
parameters.description: Snapshot timestamp used to exclude expired direct grants.

proposed_tools.sql: SELECT * FROM (SELECT ga.account_id AS account_id, ga.login AS login, 'direct' AS access_path, grc.permission_id AS permission_id, NULL AS membership_id, gr.repository_id AS repository_id, gr.name AS repository_name, gr.sensitivity AS sensitivity, gr.visibility AS visibility, gr.archived AS archived, grc.permission AS permission, grc.approval_reference AS approval_reference, grc.granted_at AS granted_at, grc.expires_at AS expires_at FROM github_accounts ga JOIN github_repo_collaborators grc ON grc.account_id = ga.account_id AND grc.revoked_at IS NULL AND (grc.expires_at IS NULL OR grc.expires_at > :snapshot_at) JOIN github_repositories gr ON gr.repository_id = grc.repository_id WHERE ga.account_id = :account_id UNION ALL SELECT ga.account_id, ga.login, 'team', gtrp.permission_id, gtm.membership_id, gr.repository_id, gr.name, gr.sensitivity, gr.visibility, gr.archived, gtrp.permission, NULL, gtrp.granted_at, NULL FROM github_accounts ga JOIN github_team_memberships gtm ON gtm.account_id = ga.account_id AND gtm.revoked_at IS NULL JOIN github_team_repo_permissions gtrp ON gtrp.team_id = gtm.team_id AND gtrp.revoked_at IS NULL JOIN github_repositories gr ON gr.repository_id = gtrp.repository_id WHERE ga.account_id = :account_id) x ORDER BY repository_name, access_path

proposed_tools.name: get_current_github_memberships
proposed_tools.description: Returns current organization and team memberships for a GitHub account, including role, source, and grant IDs.
proposed_tools.sql: SELECT * FROM (SELECT ga.account_id AS account_id, ga.login AS login, 'organization' AS scope_type, gom.membership_id AS grant_id, NULL AS scope_id, NULL AS scope_name, gom.org_role AS role, gom.source AS source, gom.granted_at AS granted_at FROM github_accounts ga JOIN github_org_memberships gom ON gom.account_id = ga.account_id AND gom.revoked_at IS NULL WHERE ga.account_id = :account_id UNION ALL SELECT ga.account_id, ga.login, 'team', gtm.membership_id, gt.team_id, gt.name, gtm.role, gtm.source, gtm.granted_at FROM github_accounts ga JOIN github_team_memberships gtm ON gtm.account_id = ga.account_id AND gtm.revoked_at IS NULL JOIN github_teams gt ON gt.team_id = gtm.team_id WHERE ga.account_id = :account_id) x ORDER BY scope_type, scope_name

proposed_tools.name: get_account_audit_events_since
proposed_tools.description: Returns audit events where an account was the typed actor or target since a supplied timestamp.
proposed_tools.sql: SELECT event_id, occurred_at, system, event_type, actor_type, actor_id, target_type, target_id, source, outcome, details_json FROM audit_events WHERE occurred_at >= :since_at AND ((actor_type = 'account' AND actor_id = :account_id) OR (target_type = 'account' AND target_id = :account_id)) ORDER BY occurred_at DESC
